openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: Dual Band (concurrent) and Gigabit Ethernet. Advertised as 900 Mbps it has simultaneous Triple-Stream (3x3) radios on both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Bands.
openwrt_wiki.Revisionen: V1.x: target mpc85xx, 800MHz Freescale PPC P1014 CPU, 3 internal antennas (2.4 GHz) and 3 external antennas (5 GHz), available world-wide; V2.x: target ar71xx, 720MHz Qualcomm/Atheros SoC and 6 external antennas, available in PRC only
openwrt_wiki.U-Boot-Log v1.x: U-Boot 2010.12-svn15934 (Dec 11 2012 - 16:23:49); CPU: P1014, Version: 1.0, (0x80f10110); Core: E500, Version: 5.1; CPU0 800 MHz, CCB 400 MHz, DDR 333.333 MHz (666.667 MT/s data rate) (Asynchronous), IFC 100 MHz; L1 D-cache 32 kB, I-cache 32 kB; Board: P1014RDB; DRAM 128 MiB; L2 256 KB; PCIe1 mini PCIe Slot 168c:abcd; PCIe2 168c:0033; AR8327/AR8328 v1.1; eTSEC1; Autobooting in 1 seconds; SF: Detected S25FL128S_65k, total 16 MiB
openwrt_wiki.VLAN: Same switch port for tagged and untagged traffic works; since 15.05 no patch needed
openwrt_wiki.Port Mirroring: Hardware port mirroring is supported in v1/(v2?) FIXME
openwrt_wiki.Serial: Serial console is available on the JP2 (v1.x) or J1 (v2.0) connector; DO NOT CONNECT VCC, use only TX/RX/GND; 115200 8N1
openwrt_wiki.Serial Löthinweis: Be extremely careful when soldering a serial console on TP-Link TL-WDR4900 - the design of the PCB is not well suited for soldering and important paths/connections are near the soldering points. We have now 3 Routers which are dead, just because we used too much solder...
openwrt_wiki.Recommendations for soldering a serial c: The through-holes for the console header are bare copper which grow an oxide layer over time (aggressive flux or abrade); PCB has extensive ground planes, higher power iron / low temperature solder / preheat
openwrt_wiki.JTAG: Insert photo of PCB with markings for JTAG port (keine Belegung angegeben)
openwrt_wiki.Installation: OpenWrt factory image may be installed via the OEM firmware on both versions
openwrt_wiki.Recovery TFTP + Serial v1.x: U-Boot prompt by typing 'vl' at 'Autobooting in 1 seconds'; tftpboot 0x1000000; sf probe 0; sf erase 0x60000 0xf80000; sf write 0x1000000 0x60000 0xf80000
openwrt_wiki.Recovery Reset Button: TFTP server on 192.168.0.66/24, image named wdr4900v1_tp_recovery.bin, keep WPS/Reset pressed while powering on
openwrt_wiki.Failsafe: quickly and repeatedly press WPS/Reset button before the front panel star LED starts flashing
openwrt_wiki.Hardware mods: Overclocking via boot straps (RAM/CPU clocks), CPU up to 1.4 GHz with over-volting (forum.openwrt.org/t/133445, kittenlabs.de)
openwrt_wiki.OpenWrt bootlog (4.19.53): Freescale P1014 machine; Total RAM 0x8000000; m25p80 spi0.0: s25fl128s (16384 Kbytes); partitions u-boot 0x0-0x50000, dtb 0x50000-0x60000, firmware 0x60000-0xfe0000, config 0xfe0000-0xff0000, caldata 0xff0000-0x1000000; switch0: Atheros AR8327 rev. 4; fsl-ehci 1 port, hub 1-1 4 ports detected; phy0 Atheros AR9300 Rev:4, phy1 Atheros AR9300 Rev:3

tplink_datenblatt.Features: Simultaneous 2.4GHz 450Mbps and 5GHz 450Mbps connections for 900Mbps; Full gigabit ports; WAN to LAN throughput of over 900Mbps with hardware NAT; 2*USB 2.0 port (FTP server, print server); Three 5GHz external detachable antennas and three 2.4GHz internal antennas; IPv6
tplink_datenblatt.Interface: 4 10/100/1000Mbps LAN Ports, 1 10/100/1000Mbps WAN Port, 2 USB 2.0 Port
tplink_datenblatt.Button: WPS/Reset Button, Wireless On/Off Switch, Power On/Off Button
tplink_datenblatt.Antenna type: Three 5GHz 5dBi detachable antennas (RP-SMA), Three 2.4GHz internal antennas
tplink_datenblatt.Wireless Functions: Enable/Disable Wireless Radio, WDS Bridge, WMM, Wireless Statistics
tplink_datenblatt.Wireless Security: 64/128-bit WEP, WPA / WPA2, WPA-PSK/ WPA2-PSK encryption
tplink_datenblatt.DHCP: Server, Client, DHCP Client List, Address Reservation
tplink_datenblatt.Port Forwarding: Virtual Server, Port Triggering, UPnP, DMZ
tplink_datenblatt.Access Control: Parental Control, Local Management Control, Host List, Access Schedule, Rule Management
tplink_datenblatt.Firewall Security: DoS, SPI Firewall, IP Address Filter/MAC Address Filter/Domain Filter, IP and MAC Address Binding
tplink_datenblatt.USB Sharing: Support Samba(Storage)/FTP Server/Media Server/Printer Server, Access Control
tplink_datenblatt.System Requirements: Microsoft Windows 8/7/Vista/XP/2000/NT/98SE, MAC OS, NetWare, UNIX or Linux.
tplink_datenblatt.Environment: Operating Temperature: 0℃~40℃ (32℉~104℉); Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ (-40℉~158℉); Operating Humidity: 10%~90% non-condensing; Storage Humidity: 5%~90% non-condensing
tplink_datenblatt.Package: N900 Wireless Dual Band Gigabit Router TL-WDR4900, 3 detachable antennas, Power supply unit, Resource CD, Quick Installation Guide

tplink_qig.Package Contents: TL-WDR4900, Power Adapter, Ethernet Cable, Resource CD, QIG
tplink_qig.Rückseite (Zeichnung, links nach rechts): Power, On/Off, Wireless On/Off, USB1, USB LED (2), USB2, Internet, Ethernet 1 2 3 4, WPS/Reset
